tools.name: list_generators
tools.description: Discover the ten free active prompt generators and supported languages. No account or payment required.

tools.name: get_generator_details
tools.description: Read all exact field names and allowed choices for a generator and locale. Call this before generate_prompt. For travel planning provide the actual destination in source_text (unless choosing a destination); for cooking, do not assume ingredients are provided.

tools.name: generate_prompt
tools.description: Generate a text prompt, not an AI response. First get_generator_details; use exact fields and choices.
